critical_blockers.finding: Before the drain starts, the core has no stream for handler-thread SSE writes on TinyHttpd. NaruServe-api/src/main/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/spi/HttpExchange.java:89 `void eventStream(int, List, StreamDrain)` returns nothing, and spi/StreamDrain.java:13 `drain(OutputStream out)` is the only hand-over of the stream. On TinyHttpd the drain is run on the worker only after the handler returned (FR-SSE-003 AC-2; TinyHttpdExchange.run). IR-HTTP-007 AC-4 and IR-WS-002 AC-5 allow no SPI member other than HttpExchange.webSocket and the three WebSocket types. FR-SSE-002 AC-5/AC-6 and FR-SSE-003 AC-6 ('straight to the committed stream under the exchange lock') therefore cannot be met as specified. Only an unbounded pre-drain buffer (against the socket-pacing intent and I-012) or a non-SPI back channel would pass them.
